close_reason: Decision recorded: CRLF validation on all fields including server-set ones is intentional header-injection defense
description: handle_mdn_send step 4 validates CRLF-cleanliness on ALL Mdn string fields before passing to the backend, including fields the spec marks as server-set (mdn_gateway, original_message_id, etc.) because the Mdn struct is shared between send and parse and a client can supply those fields. The comment explains this explicitly. A future contributor might suggest removing validation for server-set fields — don't. The validation is defense-in-depth against header injection in any RFC 5322 generator the backend might use.
title: CRLF injection defense: all client-controlled Mdn fields checked before reaching backend
